title: signer environment
description: Environment of the signer HTTP service (src/main.ts, parsed by src/config.ts). Values are strings. Private keys reach the process ONLY through the selected key provider; API keys are configured as SHA-256 hashes (mint one with `pnpm --filter @bsh/edge` `generateApiKey`).

HOST.description: Bind address. Keep loopback or a private interface; the service must never be reachable from the internet.

SIGNER_NETWORK.description: Used to render output addresses for policies and audit records.

SIGNER_KEY_PROVIDER.description: env: keys from SIGNER_KEY_<ID> variables (scrubbed from process.env after load). file: DEVELOPMENT ONLY, a 0600 JSON file. HSM providers are wired in code (see README).

SIGNER_KEY_IDS.description: Comma-separated key ids served by the env provider, e.g. `blockspace-certify,scribbit-parent`. Each needs SIGNER_KEY_<ID upper-cased, - and . replaced by _>=<32-byte hex>. Secret path: services/signer/keys/<id>.

SIGNER_KEY_FILE.description: file provider: path to `{ "keys": [{ "id", "privateKeyHex" }] }`, mode 0600, owned by the service user.

SIGNER_ALLOW_FILE_KEYS_ON_MAINNET.description: The file provider refuses to start on mainnet without this explicit override.

SIGNER_ALLOWED_PURPOSES.description: Comma-separated attestation purposes /v1/sign/digest may sign (e.g. `blockspace.certify`). Empty disables digest signing.

SIGNER_ALLOWED_SIGHASH.description: Comma-separated BIP341 hash types the taproot path may sign. Add 0x81/0x83 only for keys whose spends are designed for ANYONECANPAY.

SIGNER_MAX_INPUT_SATS.description: Policy: refuse to sign an input worth more than this.

SIGNER_MAX_FEE_SATS.description: Policy: refuse a transaction whose fee (sum inputs - sum outputs) exceeds this.

SIGNER_OUTPUT_ALLOWLIST.description: Policy: comma-separated addresses or scriptPubKey hex; every output must be one of them.

SIGNER_API_KEY_ENV.description: Only API keys of this environment are accepted.

SIGNER_API_KEYS_JSON.description: JSON array of @bsh/edge key records: [{"id","hash" (lower-case hex SHA-256 of the key),"env","scopes":["sign:<keyId>", "keys:read", "audit:read"],"expiresAt"?,"revokedAt"?,"quota"?}]. A record with a plaintext "key" field is refused. Secret path: services/signer/api-key-hashes.

SIGNER_API_KEYS_FILE.description: Path to a file with the same JSON array (merged with SIGNER_API_KEYS_JSON).

SIGNER_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of proxies we run; X-Forwarded-For is read only from them. Leave unset when reachable directly.

SIGNER_RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PER_MIN.description: Token bucket per API key on /v1/sign/*.

SIGNER_AUDIT_CAPACITY.description: Records kept in memory for GET /v1/audit. Every record is also written to stdout as JSON lines for the log pipeline.
